basis: P1 fixes 10000 draws; P3 adopts the same conservative engineering minimum before pilot validation
sufficiency: Monte Carlo floor only; not evidence of sampling coverage or power

degeneracy.latency_basis: 0.1 ms is the registered timer resolution floor: 0.05% of the fast 200 ms SLO, below any decision-relevant latency change and far above float noise on ms values. Expressed on the p95 ratio scale as 0.1/200 = 5e-4. A ratio CI narrower than one resolution unit has no resolvable uncertainty and cannot support relative_pass.
degeneracy.quality_basis: 0.001 = noninferiority margin 0.05 / 50. A metric-delta CI narrower than 2% of the margin, or a dev pilot whose per-question delta SD is below it, is constant up to float noise (e.g. summation order) and cannot establish pass or power.
degeneracy.scope: Pre-registered engineering floors before any real pilot; recheck on measured traces. Exceeding them is necessary, not sufficient, for an informative interval.
